newsitem.title: FRANCE: CLF welcomes CCB's IPO success.
newsitem.headline: CLF welcomes CCB's IPO success.

text.p: French bank Credit Local de France (CLF) expressed delight on Wednesday at the success of Belgium's Credit Communal de Belgique/Gemeentekrediet van Belgie's public share offer which it said was oversubscribed 4.7 times.
"Credit Local de France is overjoyed at the success of the sale of shares of Credit Communal-Holding/Dexia Belgium," Credit Local de France said in a statement.

The listing is part of CCB's alliance with Credit Local de France. CCB, a municipally-owned bank, and CLF plan to join forces to create Europe's 22nd largest banking group which will operate internationally under the name Dexia.
Some 11 million shares or 30 percent of Credit Communal was put on sale on November 8 at a price of 2,675 Belgian francs in one of Belgium's biggest initial public share offerings, CLF said.
